concept: 시각 의미 데이터와 후보 데이터에 반영해줘. 시각 의미 데이터의 대체 표현을 추가/보강하는 작업을 중심으로 진행하고 후보 데이터에도 잘 반영해줘. 그 다음 독립된 서브에이전트 3개에서 각각 서로 다른 컨셉으로 반영한 키워드가 이미지에 실제로 반영되는지까지 테스트할 수 있는 랜덤한 복잡한 컨셉을 정하여 테스트케이스를 마련하고 첨부한 이미지를 활용하여 프롬프트 작성하고 이미지 생성하도록 하여 잘 반영되었는지 테스트해줘.

prompt_en: A complex photographic study of a reference-informed model in a projection gallery during installation assembly: an adult woman, using the supplied reference for facial appearance, pauses while fastening the waist panel of an original synthetic song-performer costume. Her face preserves the reference's facial proportions, eye shape, nose and mouth; her eyes meet the camera with a quiet, attentive expression. Her single dusty-violet hairstyle has a compact cropped rear mass ending above the neck; two long temple locks flank the same face and reach her chest. Copper earpieces rest on her ears; one slender boom leaves her left earpiece and curves beside her cheek to end at the left mouth corner. A graphite sleeveless bodice rises into a standing collar, a narrow copper tie ending above its waist belt. Detached long sleeves expose upper-arm intervals and end at squared wrist cuffs. A short fan-pleated overskirt and translucent flexible side panel hang from the belt. Her left thumb and forefinger guide the panel tab into a buckle steadied by her right hand, with both elbows softly bent. The tab bends slightly between her fingertips; tiny folds converge in the overskirt fabric around the fastening. Her left bare foot rests nearer the camera on a flat fitting mat, its upper surface and five toes exposed and smoothly joined to the same ankle; the other foot supports a stable staggered stance. She and the unfinished display form a complex interrelated visual arrangement. A partially mounted translucent screen stands behind her on an aluminum frame. Cable coils, tape, paper patterns and cut material remain on a table beside her silhouette; floor-position tape traces the assembly area. Photograph her entire figure with both ankles and complete feet in frame, from a slight left three-quarter position that exposes the cropped rear hair edge below her near ear and keeps both long front locks visible. Broad neutral overhead light keeps the face and garment joins legible; a low amber work lamp gives copper seams and the screen an understated warm gleam. Skin texture, fabric creases and brushed metal surfaces retain the sense of a physical costume fitting.
